title: My Bedroom
description: A child describes the things in their bedroom.
instructions: Read the text about a bedroom, then choose the best answer (A, B, C or D) for each question.

paragraphs.text: My bedroom is small but nice. The walls are light green. There is one window. I can see a big tree from it.
My bed is next to the window. Next to my bed, there is a little table with a lamp on it. I put my clock on the table too.
I have a desk and a chair for my homework. On the wall, there is a poster of a tiger. My clothes are in a brown cupboard. I keep my room tidy.
Under my bed, there is a big red box. I keep my toys in it. I have a toy train, some cars and a teddy bear. The teddy bear is very old. It was my dad's bear when he was a little boy.

Next to the cupboard, there is a small bookshelf. It has three shelves. I have about forty books. Most of them are about animals. My favourite book is about tigers. That is why I have a tiger poster on my wall!
In the evening, I do my homework at my desk. I turn on the lamp because the room gets dark. My cat, Bella, often sleeps on my bed. She likes the warm blanket.
Every Sunday, I clean my room. I put my toys in the box and my books on the shelves. Then my mum looks at my room. She always says, 'Good job!' My bedroom is my favourite place in the house.
